observedFailures.failure: Pattern finalization can leave the browser on the active synthesis with a duplicate-adjudication validation error.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: The recoverability session performed the core participant adjudication before running the post-decision coverage assessment, without an outer transaction spanning both steps. If that later step failed, the browser saw failure while the first adjudication remained in memory; a natural retry could append a second adjudication to the same proposal and trigger the contract error. The prior UI also did not guard the decision request against repeated in-flight clicks.

observedFailures.failure: Two visible nonterminal buttons—'Keep trying to pin it down' and 'No — keep investigating'—presented a distinction that was not legible to the participant.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: BACKEND-STATE DISTINCTION LEAK: separate refinement modes were exposed as participant choices even though both actions meant 'do not finalize; continue discovery' at the product level. The implementation detail created unnecessary decision burden.

observedFailures.failure: After accepting a pattern, the UI offered both the finite required-coverage continuation and an open-ended 'Explore another pattern' branch.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: FINITE-INSTRUMENT / OPEN-BRANCH CONFLICT: the optional branch could repeatedly create new pattern threads even though the scientific instrument already has a finite adaptive coverage target, weakening the meaning of the progress horizon and inviting an effectively endless questionnaire.

logicLessons: A participant-visible success/failure boundary must be transactional across all dependent post-decision work; never leave a durable decision committed when the browser was told the action failed.
Do not expose internal refinement-state distinctions as separate buttons unless the participant can understand and benefit from the distinction.
When a finite adaptive interview already owns completion, make that continuation the default and do not present an unlimited parallel branch as an equally normal next step.
nextVerificationBoundary: Confirm the live app finalizes a synthesis without duplicate-adjudication failure, exposes one clear nonterminal Keep investigating action plus free-form correction, and makes Continue interview the primary post-acceptance path with the unlimited Explore another pattern branch removed from the participant UI.
